summary: Independently verified all new My Wallet features end-to-end (child + parent). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass against public URL — GET /api/wallet/my-wallet returns balance, breakdown{spend,save,give}, entries, page, total_pages, total_entries; POST /api/wallet/my-wallet/entry correctly handles income (increases balance, manual_income), spend (decreases balance + updates spend breakdown), save (decreases my_wallet balance AND increases the savings jar + updates save breakdown), give (decreases my_wallet AND increases gifting jar + updates give breakdown). Overspend rejected 400 with 'You don't have that much…'; zero amount 400; invalid entry_type 400. Pagination confirmed with total_entries=27, total_pages=3, newest-first, no overlap between pages. Parent /api/parent/child/{child_id}/money-story returns identical shape for the linked child, and 403 for unlinked child. Frontend (Playwright, wallet_demo_child): /my-wallet renders balance card, add-income-btn, use-money-btn, money-chart, my-wallet-ledger. Two-step use-money dialog exposes bucket-spend/save/give; entering 5 (save/goal), 3 (give/charity), 2 (spend/toys) and 4 income (cash) took the balance 269→264→261→259→263 — each flow decreases/increases the balance and pushes a new entry. Validation: empty submit and overspend both keep the dialog open and surface an inline error toast ('That's more than you have!'). Pagination: 'Page 1 of 3' shown, wallet-prev-page disabled on page 1, wallet-next-page advances to 'Page 2 of 3', wallet-page-indicator updates. Parent (wallet_demo_parent) dashboard shows money-story-panel and money-story-btn-<child_id>; clicking opens money-story-dialog with balance ₹263, the same colourful donut chart (Spent 49%/Saved 35%/Gave 16% with sub-category chips Food & Snacks ₹45, Toys ₹32, A Goal ₹55, Charity ₹26), recent entries, and Back/Next pagination that moves Page 1→2 of 3. Everything works as specified.

issues: Back/Next/page-indicator buttons in the parent dialog lack data-testid attributes (child page uses wallet-prev-page / wallet-next-page / wallet-page-indicator). Adding e.g. money-story-prev-page / money-story-next-page / money-story-page-indicator would keep parent pagination testable via selectors.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add data-testid to parent Money Story dialog Back/Next/page indicator buttons for automated testability.
critical_code_review_comments: _build_money_story loads up to 5000 transactions in memory and filters in Python; once ledgers grow, push wallet_source: 'my_wallet' + sort+skip+limit into MongoDB.

add_my_wallet_entry does the wallet debit and the jar credit as two separate updates without a session/transaction — a mid-flight failure could leave money debited from my_wallet without landing in savings/gifting. Consider wrapping in a Mongo session txn.
Parent Money Story dialog computes pagination locally with `moneyStoryPage` state but always refetches via openMoneyStory — Back on page 2 correctly re-fetches page 1; OK but keep aware.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: child spend/save/give/income + validation + pagination + parent dialog + chart)

test_credentials: child wallet_demo_child / testpass123; parent wallet_demo_parent / testpass123 (linked to test_child_wallet_demo).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature complete and green. wallet_demo_child now has 27 my_wallet entries → total_pages=3. Parent Money Story dialog works but its pagination controls lack data-testids — this is the only outstanding polish item.
